size_rules.formula: target pixels = 1600^2 * (world area / UV triangle or frame area) / tank reference density; preserve source aspect, round long edge up to a multiple of 64, never enlarge. Solid models, ground, water, environment backgrounds and minimaps have a 2048 long-edge limit; effects have a 1024 long-edge limit. Smaller targets are retained. Screen overlays use 3840x2160 screen pixels / frame UV before applying the effect limit.
size_rules.view_basis: Equal viewing distance relative to the tank baseline; offline geometry estimate, no measured 4K screen coverage.
size_rules.model_texture_policy: Solid model textures, including buildings and trees, have a 2048 long-edge limit; smaller targets are retained and source aspect ratio is preserved.
size_rules.terrain_policy: Ground and water use world surface area / UV triangle area with a 2048 long-edge limit; smaller targets are retained and source aspect ratio is preserved. Tiled UV repeats retain their area; scrolling does not change density. Shared caustic frames use the largest waves model demand; waterfall frames share model demand.
size_rules.effect_policy: Effect textures have a 1024 long-edge limit, including screen overlays and HUD-shared effects; smaller targets and aspect ratio are retained. Sprites use maximum single-face area over their controller interval. Particles use maximum configured half-size. Strips retain repeated UVs. Geometry effects use maximum plane projections with configured scale. Shared textures use maximum demand before applying the limit.
size_rules.ui_policy: 3840x2160 viewport: maximum native control or tile size x4, including dynamic imagery; fullscreen cover uses actual 4K extent; minimaps have a 2048 long-edge limit and HUD-shared effects have a 1024 long-edge limit; never enlarge; preserve aspect ratio and native layout metrics.
size_rules.ui_settlement_policy: Settlement-only award and outcome artwork has a 512 long-edge limit; preserve aspect ratio, never enlarge, retain HD sources. Shared scoreboard and lobby artwork keeps its approved dimensions.
size_rules.mobile_policy: Mobile HD battle images are encoded directly from art/hd at the matching nostalgic texture dimensions. Each image records mobile_target_size and mobile_size_basis; source paths, source dimensions, categories and encoding profiles are shared with the desktop recipe. Shared nostalgic images without an original source retain the desktop target size. Preserve aspect ratio, never enlarge. Embedded images follow their original GLB image dimensions. Mobile minimaps reuse the separately authored 512x512 nostalgic backgrounds; UI artwork keeps its existing recipe.
